name: Trusted contacts
title: The people Rouh may act for and answer, and what each may ask

permissions: grants trusted contacts authority over goals, quests and tasks (DELEGATION.md)

one access level per task per contact - none, read or edit - read by Rouh's pages, email, Telegram and the case gate alike, set beside each task on the contact's page; a task they start is theirs to edit, and a task under a ticked project is shared with them to read (rouh/task_access.py, MAIL.md D28)
every task made for somebody outside is shared with them to edit as it is made, and they are emailed its link once (rouh/requester_share.py)
Your calendar is given one calendar at a time, and a contact's case may change only the calendars ticked for them (grants.calendars_of)
touches.remove: the Settings group's own cards in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html and its script; see MAIL.md and DELEGATION.md before removing anything.

capabilities.name: Answer them
capabilities.said: have their questions answered in the reply, on their own email, Telegram or Slack
capabilities.about: Communication on their page: every contact who is not switched off holds it. An answer alone needs nothing else.

capabilities.name: Read a task
capabilities.said: read the task and answer from it
capabilities.about: Their read, edit or decide on the task, from the one permission record, inherited from a quest or a parent task.

capabilities.name: Change a task
capabilities.said: add to or change the task
capabilities.about: Their edit or decide on the task. Rouh adds a dated entry, attributed to them, to the task named, and to no other.

capabilities.name: Ask AI on a task
capabilities.said: use Ask AI or a chat with Rouh on the task's pages

capabilities.name: Be let in to a task
capabilities.said: change the task and use Ask AI on its pages themselves
capabilities.about: The permission itself: when they hold edit or decide, the gate tells them so and nothing else is done.

capabilities.name: Decide for you
capabilities.said: decide for you on the task
capabilities.about: Decide on the task, its quest or goal (DELEGATION.md). delegate_act checks the sender, their own words and the scope itself, and never money, deleting, publishing, sending or anybody's grants.

capabilities.name: Share a page
capabilities.said: have pages of tasks they may read shared with them
capabilities.about: Your tasks on their page. share_granted_page shares only a page of a task they may read, or one done for them, with their own address.

capabilities.name: Make a shared task
capabilities.said: have a new task made in your Personal column that you and they both add to

per_day.said: up to {n} new tasks a day

capabilities.name: Keep a note
capabilities.said: keep notes they give in your memory, marked as theirs
capabilities.about: A note goes into Synapse Master as from them, by name and address, and dated. It never writes a rule for Rouh and never changes what is kept.
